items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bußgeldbescheid mit dem Einspruch anfechten; er muss innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung vorliegen (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG), schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhalle – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: This is a förmliche Zustellung (formal service via Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO), shown on page 2 with the delivery date noted as 24.04.2027 (a Saturday) — this actual service date governs, not the ordinary 'deemed delivery' rule for authority post. Counting starts the day after service (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): 25.04.2027. Two weeks (14 days) later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) falls on 08.05.2027, a Saturday. Under § 43 StPO (applied via § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG), a period ending on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday ends on the next working day: Monday 10.05.2027.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft fällig.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (legal force, § 84 OWiG) occurs once the Einspruch period expires without an objection being filed, i.e. the day after 10.05.2027 = 11.05.2027. 'Zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft' then runs from the day after that event (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB): counting starts 12.05.2027 (wait, verified via tool using 11.05.2027 as the event date), two weeks later lands on Tuesday 25.05.2027, a working day, so no further shift applies (§ 193 BGB). This date is contingent: it only holds if no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch would postpone Rechtskraft and this payment date.

warnings: The payment due date (25.05.2027) assumes no Einspruch is filed; if an Einspruch is lodged by 10.05.2027, Rechtskraft (and therefore the payment date) is postponed until the objection proceedings conclude.

The IBAN printed (DE75 8005 3762 0002 2100 00) is a valid German IBAN at a named Saalesparkasse — before paying, confirm it matches the Bußgeldstelle's known account details, especially since a payee-name check (Empfängerüberprüfung) is now required for euro transfers.
